SysDataModelXML.SQLScript: DECLARE @POHNUM VARCHAR(30) = '{0}' SELECT S.[ID] ,S.[FILKEY] ,S.[FILGRP] ,T.OPTDES FILGRPDES ,S.[FILTYP] ,S.[FILNAM] text ,S.[FILDES] ,S.[FILDIR] ,S.[FILURL] name ,S.[FILURL] picture ,S.[SRCTYP] ,S.[SRCDOC] ,S.[SRCLIN] ,S.[REMARK] ,S.[FLG01] ,S.[FLG02] ,ISNULL(U.Name,S.[CREUSR]) CREUSR ,S.[UPDUSR] ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(16),S.[CRETIM],21) CRETIM ,S.[UPDTIM] FROM [LINKDOCFIL] S LEFT JOIN LINK.dbo.SysUser U ON S.[CREUSR]=U.LoginUser LEFT JOIN LINKOPT T ON S.FILGRP=T.OPTID WHERE (S.SRCDOC=@POHNUM OR SRCDOC = ( SELECT INVNO FROM PBOLH WHERE DOCNUM = @POHNUM AND ISNULL(INVNO,'')<> '' ) OR SRCDOC = ( SELECT BLNO FROM PBOLH WHERE DOCNUM = @POHNUM AND ISNULL(BLNO,'') <> '' )) AND ISNULL(S.SRCDOC,'') <>'' AND S.SRCTYP = N'PBO' --20250220区分提单与订单 ORDER BY S.ID
SysDataModelXML.SQLUpdateScript: --LINKAUTOREPLACEEMPTYCOLUMNS UPDATE LINKDOCFIL SET FILGRP='#FILGRP#' ,FILDES='#FILDES#' ,REMARK='#REMARK#' WHERE FILKEY='#FILKEY#';
